The per-member rule is licensed in shape (counted plural + distributive predicate), but it propagates the same mis-slotted head, asserting spatial containment of each kid.

gaps_confirmed: being 'in' an event or competition stage ('in the third round', 'in the final') — participation has no head of its own; only the framing-PP route ('in fluid mechanics' -> the preposition-named In) comes close

Ordinal's <scale> slot when the entity is ranked within a sequence of its own kind ('the third round') — the scale is specified as the associated event or an explicit '-est' dimension, neither of which exists here
new_gaps: whether an entity-attached PP post-modifier on a counted plural ('two kids from Michigan') should distribute to the members alongside the predicate's per-member rule, or stay on the group symbol alone, is unsettled
repair_summary: Replaced LocatedIn with the preposition-named oblique In in both the group atom and the per-member rule, following the instruction set's own route for an 'in' whose object is not a place ('in fluid mechanics' -> (In ...)); nothing else changed.
